# The roll decides your material cost, not the vehicle.

> Free calculator for independent vehicle wrap and graphics shops: price a full or partial wrap from vehicle surface area, material waste factor, install complexity, and labor, then see exactly what a waste-blind quote loses on every job.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
